```{r setup, include=FALSE}
run_models <- identical(Sys.getenv("SURVEYPREV_RUN_VIGNETTES"), "true")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = TRUE, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>",
  message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5,
  out.width = "100%", fig.align = "center", cache = TRUE
)
library(surveyPrev)
library(ggplot2)
library(rdhs)
```

In this vignette, we compare the main model classes using INLA and Stan. We download the Zambia 2024 DHS data directly from the DHS website using the **rdhs** package. This step requires users to

1. register with DHS to gain data access,
2. set up the DHS account login details in R with `rdhs::set_rdhs_config()`.

```{r data}
dhs_raw <- getDHSdata(
  country = "Zambia", year = 2024, indicator = "RH_ANCN_W_N4P"
)
anc <- getDHSindicator(dhs_raw, indicator = "RH_ANCN_W_N4P")
gps <- getDHSgeo(country = "Zambia", year = 2024)

data(ZambiaAdm1)
data(ZambiaAdm2)
data(ZambiaPopWomen)
cluster_info <- clusterInfo(gps, ZambiaAdm1, ZambiaAdm2)
admin1_info <- adminInfo(
  ZambiaAdm1, admin = 1, by.adm = "NAME_1",
  agg.pop = ZambiaPopWomen$admin1_pop,
  proportion = ZambiaPopWomen$admin1_urban
)
admin2_info <- adminInfo(
  ZambiaAdm2, admin = 2, by.adm = "NAME_2", by.adm.upper = "NAME_1",
  agg.pop = ZambiaPopWomen$admin2_pop,
  proportion = ZambiaPopWomen$admin2_urban
)
```

Each Stan fit uses three chains, 2,000 warmup iterations, and 2,000 retained
posterior draws per chain. The sampler arguments are shown explicitly below so
they can be changed in one place.

We start with a few helper functions that simplify the comparison scripts later.

```{r helpers}
fit_both <- function(fun, args) {
  list(
    INLA = do.call(fun, c(args, list(engine = "INLA"))),
    Stan = do.call(fun, c(args, list(
      engine = "rstan",
      stan.chains = 3,
      stan.iter = 4000,
      stan.warmup = 2000,
      stan.seed = 12345
    )))
  )
}

model_table <- function(x) {
  candidates <- c("res.admin1", "res.admin2", "agg.admin1", "smooth")
  for (name in candidates) if (!is.null(x[[name]])) return(x[[name]])
  stop("No model estimate table found.")
}

compare_scatter <- function(pair, title) {
  x <- model_table(pair$INLA)
  y <- model_table(pair$Stan)
  keys <- intersect(
    c("admin1.name", "admin2.name.full", "region", "strata"),
    intersect(names(x), names(y))
  )
  if (length(keys)) {
    x <- x[do.call(order, x[keys]), ]
    y <- y[do.call(order, y[keys]), ]
  }
  n <- min(nrow(x), nrow(y))
  x <- x[seq_len(n), ]
  y <- y[seq_len(n), ]
  sx <- if ("sd" %in% names(x)) x$sd else sqrt(x$var)
  sy <- if ("sd" %in% names(y)) y$sd else sqrt(y$var)
  plot_data <- rbind(
    data.frame(metric = "estimate", INLA = x$mean, Stan = y$mean),
    data.frame(metric = "standard error", INLA = sx, Stan = sy)
  )
  axis_bounds <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(plot_data, plot_data$metric),
    function(z) {
      values <- c(z$INLA, z$Stan)
      values <- values[is.finite(values)]
      limits <- if (length(values)) range(values) else c(0, 1)
      if (diff(limits) == 0) limits <- limits + c(-0.5, 0.5)
      data.frame(metric = z$metric[1], INLA = limits, Stan = limits)
    }
  ))
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(INLA, Stan)) +
    geom_blank(data = axis_bounds) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60",
                linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
}
```


## Fay--Herriot IID random effect, admin 1

```{r fh-iid}
fh_iid <- fit_both(fhModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin1_info,
  admin = 1, model = "iid", aggregation = FALSE
))
compare_scatter(fh_iid, "Fay-Herriot IID, admin 1")
```

Some computational checks are available using the `diagModel` function.

```{r fh-iid-diagnostics}
diagModel(fh_iid$INLA)
diagModel(fh_iid$Stan)
```

## Fay--Herriot BYM2 random effect, admin 1

```{r fh-bym2}
fh_bym2 <- fit_both(fhModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin1_info,
  admin = 1, model = "bym2", aggregation = TRUE
))
compare_scatter(fh_bym2, "Fay-Herriot BYM2, admin 1")
```

 

## Fay--Herriot nested BYM2 random effect, admin 2, with variance fix

The sparse admin-2 direct estimates require the explicit variance-fix estimator.

```{r fh-nested}
fh_nested <- fit_both(fhModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin2_info,
  admin = 2, model = "bym2", nested = TRUE, aggregation = FALSE,
  var.fix = TRUE
))
compare_scatter(fh_nested, "Fay-Herriot nested BYM2 with variance fix")
```

 

## Cluster-level IID random effect, admin 1

```{r cluster-iid}
cluster_iid <- fit_both(clusterModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin1_info,
  admin = 1, model = "iid", aggregation = FALSE
))
compare_scatter(cluster_iid, "Cluster IID, admin 1")
```

 

## Cluster-level BYM2 random effect, admin 1

```{r cluster-bym2}
cluster_bym2 <- fit_both(clusterModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin1_info,
  admin = 1, model = "bym2", aggregation = FALSE
))
compare_scatter(cluster_bym2, "Cluster BYM2, admin 1")
```

 
## Cluster-level stratified BYM2 random effect

```{r cluster-stratified}
cluster_stratified <- fit_both(clusterModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin1_info,
  admin = 1, model = "bym2", stratification = TRUE,
  aggregation = TRUE
))
compare_scatter(cluster_stratified, "Cluster stratified BYM2")
```

 

## Cluster-level nested BYM2 random effect, admin 2

```{r cluster-nested}
cluster_nested <- fit_both(clusterModel, list(
  data = anc, cluster.info = cluster_info, admin.info = admin2_info,
  admin = 2, model = "bym2", nested = TRUE, aggregation = FALSE
))
compare_scatter(cluster_nested, "Cluster nested BYM2, admin 2")
```
